description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the LeaveRequestCommentService in the OrangeHRM HRM system. It sets up a test case to verify the behavior of the service, including a test method to confirm that the DAO (Data Access Object) returned by the service is an instance of LeaveRequestCommentDao.

classes.name: LeaveRequestCommentServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LeaveRequestCommentService component in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case by creating an instance of LeaveRequestCommentService before each test.

methods.name: testGetLeaveRequestCommentDao
methods.description: Tests that getLeaveRequestCommentDao() returns an instance of LeaveRequestCommentDao.
